module_name_en: Core Words III and Graded Reading
block_note: Seven of the twelve news words have already appeared in example sentences across earlier levels — सरकार, चुनाव, नीति, प्रदर्शन, घोषणा, अदालत and संसद. That is deliberate: the block confirms words the learner has been meeting in passing rather than introducing twelve at once, and levels 38 to 40 then read them.

learn.explanation_en: फ़र्क़ is a difference, and अंतर is its Sanskrit-side partner. Both are masculine, so flag फ़र्क़ for the consonant ending alone. The reason to learn फ़र्क़ first is the idiom: फ़र्क़ पड़ना, for something to make a difference, and above all कोई फ़र्क़ नहीं पड़ता, it doesn't matter. That sentence is everywhere. अंतर, meanwhile, owns the compounds — अंतर्राष्ट्रीय international, अंतरिक्ष space — and फ़र्क़ builds nothing, which is the same asymmetry you saw with मुल्क and देश.

examples.note: पड़ना, for a difference to fall. Learn it whole.

examples.english: What's the difference between the two?
examples.note: में on what the difference lies between.

examples.hindi: दोनों के बीच का अंतर स्पष्ट है।
examples.read_as: donoṁ ke biich kaa aṁtar spaṣṭ hai.
examples.english: The difference between the two is clear.
examples.note: The formal partner, and a sentence you would write rather than say.

common_error.why_en: फ़र्क़ builds no compounds at all. The free words swap; the compounds are fixed.

practice.prompt_en: कोई फ़र्क़ नहीं पड़ता means what?
options: There is no difference at all
practice.explanation_en: Literally no difference falls. Idiomatically, it makes no odds.

game.explanation_en: अंतर plus राष्ट्र, nation. अंतरिक्ष is space and अंतिम is final.

items.pronunciation_notes: Refer to romanized transliteration for pronunciation.

learn.title_en: क़िस्मत is feminine and भाग्य is masculine
learn.explanation_en: The seventh mismatched pair in this module. क़िस्मत is what people say — क़िस्मत अच्छी है, क़िस्मत वाला, meaning lucky — and भाग्य is the written and ceremonial word. Flag क़िस्मत: feminine, consonant-final. And once again the Sanskrit side has the compounds: भाग्यशाली fortunate, दुर्भाग्य misfortune, सौभाग्य good fortune. There is no क़िस्मतशाली.

examples.note: उसकी and अच्छी, both feminine.
साथ देना, to support — and क़िस्मत takes ने because देना is transitive.
दुर्- is a prefix meaning bad, related to the कु- in कुतर्क from level 11.

common_error.why_en: क़िस्मत is feminine, though भाग्य, which means the same, is masculine.

practice.explanation_en: भाग्य is masculine and क़िस्मत is feminine — the seventh mismatched pair in the module.

game.explanation_en: भाग्यशाली, with -शाली meaning possessing. दुर्भाग्य is misfortune.

items.pronunciation_notes: Refer to romanized transliteration for pronunciation.

learn.title_en: इज़्ज़त is owed to you; सम्मान is conferred on you
learn.explanation_en: The eighth mismatched pair — इज़्ज़त feminine, सम्मान masculine — so flag इज़्ज़त — and this one differs in meaning as well as register. इज़्ज़त is the respect you are owed as a person, which can be given, kept or lost: इज़्ज़त करना, इज़्ज़त बचाना. सम्मान is honour that is formally conferred — a सम्मान समारोह is an award ceremony, and सम्मानित करना is to honour somebody publicly. You can lose your इज़्ज़त; you cannot lose a सम्मान once it has been given.

examples.note: करनी, feminine, agreeing with इज़्ज़त — the obligation ladder from Module 11.
मिला, masculine, agreeing with सम्मान. This sense needs the formal word.
बढ़ी, feminine. इज़्ज़त can go up and down; a सम्मान cannot.

common_error.why_en: An award is a सम्मान. इज़्ज़त is not something an institution hands out.

practice.prompt_en: Which word would name a national award?
practice.explanation_en: सम्मान is honour conferred. इज़्ज़त is standing you hold.

game.question_en: Which word means dignity or self-respect?
game.explanation_en: आत्म- means self, so आत्मसम्मान is self-respect. आदर is deference shown to somebody, as in आदरणीय.

items.pronunciation_notes: Refer to romanized transliteration for pronunciation.

summary.recap_en: That closes the pairs. Roughly half of the seventeen in this module change gender across the register and roughly half do not, so there is nothing to derive — each pair has to be known. What does hold every time is that the Sanskrit side takes the compounds: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय, भाग्यशाली, सम्मानित, and no फ़र्क़- or क़िस्मत- equivalents at all.
summary.next_up_en: Next: the vocabulary of the news, starting with government and elections.

learn.title_en: सरकार is feminine, and सरकारी is everywhere
learn.explanation_en: सरकार is the government, and it is feminine despite the consonant ending, so flag it — सरकार ने कहा, but नई सरकार and राज्य सरकार ने घोषणा की. The adjective सरकारी is one of the most useful words in the language: सरकारी नौकरी a government job, सरकारी अस्पताल a state hospital, सरकारी काम officialdom in general. You have already seen सरकार in an example back in level 17, doing exactly what it does in the news.

examples.hindi: सरकार ने नई नीति की घोषणा की।
examples.read_as: sarkaar ne naii niiti kii ghoṣṇaa kii.
examples.english: The government announced a new policy.
examples.note: Three of this level's words in one sentence, and every agreement feminine.
सरकारी, invariable like all -ी adjectives.

examples.hindi: राज्य सरकार का फ़ैसला अलग है।
examples.read_as: raajya sarkaar kaa faislaa alag hai.
examples.english: The state government's decision is different.
examples.note: का agrees with फ़ैसला, not with सरकार.

practice.explanation_en: सरकारी is the adjective from सरकार.

game.question_en: Which word means administration in the sense of day-to-day running?
game.explanation_en: प्रशासन is the administration. राज्य is a state, and it is also the word for rule or reign.

tts_strings: सरकार ने नई नीति की घोषणा की।

items.pronunciation_notes: Refer to romanized transliteration for pronunciation.

learn.explanation_en: चुनना is to choose and चुनाव is an election — or a choice, in the ordinary sense. Flag चुनाव: masculine and consonant-final. The suffix -आव turns a verb into a noun, and unlike every other noun-building suffix in this module, it produces masculines: बदलाव change, बहाव flow, झुकाव leaning, दबाव pressure, फैलाव spread. You met बदलाव on the returns sign in level 22 without being told what built it. After four feminine suffixes — -आई, -ई, -ता, -ति — this is the first that goes the other way.

examples.note: Masculine plural, so होंगे.

examples.hindi: आपके पास कोई चुनाव नहीं है।
examples.read_as: aapke paas koii chunaav nahiiṁ hai.
examples.note: The everyday sense, and के पास doing the work of "have".

examples.english: There will be no change in this.
examples.note: बदलाव, another -आव noun, also masculine.

common_error.why_en: -आव nouns are masculine. होंगी would need a feminine subject.

practice.explanation_en: चुनाव, बदलाव, बहाव, दबाव — all masculine, and all built from verbs.

game.explanation_en: दबाव, from दबाना, to press. बहाव is flow and झुकाव is a leaning or inclination.

items.pronunciation_notes: Refer to romanized transliteration for pronunciation.

learn.title_en: नीति — a policy, and also a principle
learn.explanation_en: नीति is a policy in the news sense — विदेश नीति foreign policy, नई शिक्षा नीति a new education policy — and it also means ethics or right conduct, which is why a moral fable is a नीति कथा and why ईमानदारी सबसे अच्छी नीति है works as a proverb. It is a -ति noun like स्वीकृति from level 32, so it is feminine and predictable, which is why it is not flagged.

examples.hindi: सरकार की नई नीति आ गई है।
examples.read_as: sarkaar kii naii niiti aa gaii hai.
examples.english: The government's new policy is out.
examples.note: की and नई, both feminine.
The proverb, using नीति in its other sense — and सबसे for the superlative, from level 32.
नीतिगत, policy-related, with the -गत suffix meaning pertaining to.

common_error.why_en: All -ति nouns are feminine, without exception.

practice.prompt_en: Why is नीति not flagged for gender?
options: It is a -ति noun, and all of those are feminine
practice.explanation_en: स्वीकृति, प्रगति, शक्ति, नीति — the suffix settles it.

game.question_en: Which word means a rule or regulation?
game.explanation_en: नियम is a rule, and you met it on the photography sign. योजना is a scheme or plan and सिद्धांत is a principle.

tts_strings: सरकार की नई नीति आ गई है।

items.pronunciation_notes: Refer to romanized transliteration for pronunciation.

summary.recap_en: सरकार is feminine and सरकारी is one of the most useful adjectives in Hindi. -आव builds masculine nouns from verbs — चुनाव, बदलाव, दबाव — and it is the first noun suffix in this module that does not produce a feminine. And नीति is a -ति noun, so its gender needs no flag.
summary.next_up_en: Next: the economy, protests and announcements — and a class of feminine nouns that look masculine.

learn.explanation_en: अर्थव्यवस्था is अर्थ, wealth or meaning, plus व्यवस्था, a system or arrangement. And here is the thing to flag: it ends in -आ, which normally signals a masculine noun in Hindi, and it is feminine. It belongs to a class of Sanskrit-derived -आ nouns that are all feminine — व्यवस्था, समस्या, प्रतीक्षा, कृपा, सेवा, भाषा, विद्या, चर्चा, घोषणा. Every one of them looks masculine and none of them is, which makes this the most reliable trap in Hindi gender.

examples.note: रही, feminine, despite the -आ ending.
अर्थ on its own means meaning, and is masculine.
समस्या, another -आ feminine, so बड़ी.

common_error.why_en: The -आ ending is misleading. This whole class of Sanskrit nouns is feminine.

practice.explanation_en: अर्थ ends in a consonant and is masculine. The three -आ nouns are all feminine.

game.explanation_en: चर्चा, which you met as the calm alternative to बहस in level 12. All four are feminine and all four end in -आ.

items.pronunciation_notes: Refer to romanized transliteration for pronunciation.

learn.title_en: प्रदर्शन is a protest and also a performance
learn.explanation_en: प्रदर्शन comes from दर्शन, seeing, with प्र- meaning forth — a showing-forth. That gives it two lives that English keeps apart. In the news it is a demonstration or protest: किसानों का प्रदर्शन. In sport or work it is a performance: उसका प्रदर्शन अच्छा रहा. And प्रदर्शनी, feminine, is an exhibition. You met प्रदर्शन back in level 13 as the visible event, against विरोध the stance. Flag it: masculine, consonant-final.

examples.english: There was a demonstration outside parliament.
examples.note: हुआ, masculine.
Same word, and only the context separates the senses.

examples.hindi: कल से पुस्तक प्रदर्शनी शुरू है।
examples.read_as: kal se pustak pradarshanii shuruu hai.
examples.note: प्रदर्शनी, feminine, and पुस्तक the formal word for a book.

common_error.why_en: प्रदर्शन is masculine. प्रदर्शनी, the exhibition, is feminine.

practice.prompt_en: प्रदर्शन does NOT mean which of these?
practice.explanation_en: An exhibition is प्रदर्शनी, with the feminine ending.

game.question_en: Which word means a strike by workers?
game.explanation_en: हड़ताल is a strike. जुलूस is a procession or march, and विरोध is the underlying opposition.

items.pronunciation_notes: Refer to romanized transliteration for pronunciation.

learn.title_en: Another -आ feminine, and the word a manifesto is made of
learn.explanation_en: घोषणा is an announcement, and like अर्थव्यवस्था it ends in -आ and is feminine, so flag it. It goes with करना — सरकार ने घोषणा की, with की agreeing. And घोषणापत्र, an announcement-document, is a political manifesto, which is a good example of how news vocabulary is built by compounding two ordinary words rather than borrowing a new one.

examples.note: की, feminine, agreeing with घोषणा.

examples.hindi: अभी कोई घोषणा नहीं हुई है।
examples.read_as: abhii koii ghoṣṇaa nahiiṁ huii hai.
examples.english: No announcement has been made yet.
examples.note: हुई, feminine again.
घोषणापत्र is masculine, because पत्र is — the last element of a compound decides.

common_error.why_en: घोषणा is feminine, so करना agrees with it.

options: Because the last element of a compound decides, and पत्र is masculine
Because it is a political term
practice.explanation_en: The final element carries the gender, which is why घोषणा feminine gives घोषणापत्र masculine.

game.question_en: Which word means a notification issued by an authority?
game.explanation_en: अधिसूचना is a formal notification, built on सूचना from level 14 with the prefix अधि-. Note that it is feminine too.

items.pronunciation_notes: Refer to romanized transliteration for pronunciation.

summary.recap_en: Sanskrit nouns ending in -आ are feminine — व्यवस्था, समस्या, चर्चा, प्रतीक्षा, कृपा, सेवा, भाषा, घोषणा — against the general rule that -आ means masculine. That is the single most reliable gender trap in Hindi. And in a compound the last element decides: घोषणा is feminine but घोषणापत्र is masculine.
summary.next_up_en: Next: ministers, courts and law — and a sixth way of negating.

learn.explanation_en: मंत्री is a minister, and it ends in -ी and is masculine — the mirror image of the trap in the last level. Most -ी nouns are feminine, so flag this one. It joins a small masculine group: आदमी, पानी, मोती, घी, and the agent nouns like निवासी from level 32. मंत्रालय, the ministry, uses the -आलय suffix from level 8, and प्रधानमंत्री and मुख्यमंत्री are the prime minister and a state chief minister.

examples.english: The education minister issued a statement.
examples.note: बयान — a statement, and a level 38 reading item.
नए and आएँगे, masculine plural for respect.
मंत्री plus आलय, the place suffix from the toilet sign in level 8.

common_error.why_en: मंत्री is masculine despite the -ी ending. A woman minister is still मंत्री, and takes masculine agreement in the title.

practice.prompt_en: Which of these -ी nouns is feminine?
practice.explanation_en: कुर्सी is feminine. The other three are the masculine exceptions.

game.question_en: Which word means a senior civil servant rather than a politician?
game.explanation_en: अधिकारी is an official, and it is a level 40 reading item. सांसद is a member of parliament and नेता is a political leader.

items.pronunciation_notes: Refer to romanized transliteration for pronunciation.

learn.title_en: अदालत, न्यायालय, कोर्ट — three words, three registers
learn.explanation_en: अदालत is a court and it is feminine, so flag it. The Sanskrit-side word is न्यायालय — न्याय, justice, plus the आलय suffix you now know well — and it is what appears on the building and in a written judgement. And कोर्ट, the English word, is what lawyers and journalists say every day: सुप्रीम कोर्ट, हाई कोर्ट. All three are current, and which one you meet depends entirely on where you are reading.

examples.note: फ़ैसला सुनाना, to pronounce a judgement — सुनाना is the causative of सुनना.
मामला from level 17.

examples.english: It is a Supreme Court order.
examples.note: सर्वोच्च, highest. In speech, सुप्रीम कोर्ट.

common_error.wrong: अदालत का फ़ैसला सुनाया गया — with अदालत treated as masculine elsewhere
common_error.why_en: अदालत is feminine, so अपनी would be wrong here only because अपना agrees with फ़ैसला. Watch which noun the adjective is actually pointing at.

practice.prompt_en: न्यायालय is built from which two parts?
practice.explanation_en: न्याय, justice, plus आलय, place — the suffix from शौचालय and पुस्तकालय.

game.explanation_en: न्यायाधीश is a judge, and जज is what everybody says. वकील is a lawyer.

items.pronunciation_notes: Refer to romanized transliteration for pronunciation.

learn.title_en: ग़ैर- is a sixth way of saying not
learn.explanation_en: क़ानून is law, masculine and consonant-final, so flag it. क़ानूनी means legal — and its negative is ग़ैरक़ानूनी, illegal, using ग़ैर-, which came into Hindi through Persian and Arabic and means non- or un-. That is the sixth negation device in this module, after निः-, ला-, अ-, बिना and ना-. ग़ैर- is productive: ग़ैरहाज़िर absent, ग़ैरज़रूरी unnecessary, ग़ैरसरकारी non-governmental. It attaches to Urdu-side words, just as अ- attaches to Sanskrit-side ones.

examples.note: के ख़िलाफ़, against — a postposition worth having.
The sort of sentence a news report is built from.

examples.hindi: नया क़ानून अगले महीने से लागू होगा।
examples.read_as: nayaa qaanuun agle mahiine se laaguu hogaa.
examples.english: The new law comes into force next month.
examples.note: लागू होना, to come into effect. लागू is invariable.

common_error.why_en: Each prefix stays on its own side. अ- attaches to Sanskrit-side words and ग़ैर- to Urdu-side ones, exactly as with नामुमकिन and असंभव in level 28.

practice.prompt_en: What does the prefix ग़ैर- mean?
practice.explanation_en: ग़ैरक़ानूनी illegal, ग़ैरज़रूरी unnecessary, ग़ैरसरकारी non-governmental.

game.question_en: Which word means a non-governmental organisation?
game.explanation_en: ग़ैरसरकारी संगठन, using सरकारी from level 34 and संगठन, organisation.

tts_strings: नया क़ानून अगले महीने से लागू होगा।

items.pronunciation_notes: Refer to romanized transliteration for pronunciation.

summary.recap_en: मंत्री is masculine despite ending in -ी, which is the mirror of the -आ feminines in the last level. A court is अदालत, न्यायालय or कोर्ट depending on where you are reading. And ग़ैर- is a sixth negative prefix, attaching to Urdu-side words as अ- attaches to Sanskrit-side ones.
summary.next_up_en: Next: budget, development and parliament — the last three news words.

learn.title_en: An English word taking Hindi grammar entirely
learn.explanation_en: बजट is the English word and it is masculine — flag it, because a loanword's gender is never predictable. What is worth noticing is how completely it has been absorbed: बजट पेश करना or बजट प्रस्तुत करना to present the budget, बजट सत्र the budget session, बजट में कटौती a cut in the budget. It takes the oblique, takes postpositions and appears in compounds like any Hindi noun. Compare टिप, which turned out to be feminine in Module 12 — there is no rule, only the fact.

examples.hindi: वित्त मंत्री ने बजट प्रस्तुत किया।
examples.read_as: vitt maṁtrii ne bajaṭ prastut kiyaa.
examples.english: The finance minister presented the budget.
examples.note: प्रस्तुत करना from level 19, and किया masculine.

examples.hindi: इस बजट में शिक्षा पर ज़्यादा ख़र्च है।
examples.read_as: is bajaṭ meṁ shikṣaa par zyaadaa ḳharch hai.
examples.english: There is more spending on education in this budget.
examples.note: इस, oblique before में.

examples.hindi: बजट सत्र सोमवार से शुरू होगा।
examples.read_as: bajaṭ satra somvaar se shuruu hogaa.
examples.english: The budget session begins on Monday.
examples.note: सत्र, a session — a Sanskrit word attached directly to an English one.

common_error.wrong: इस बजट में कटौती की गई है — with बजट treated as feminine
common_error.why_en: बजट is masculine. Loanword genders have to be learned one at a time.

practice.prompt_en: How is a loanword's gender decided in Hindi?
options: There is no rule — it is assigned and must be learned
practice.explanation_en: बजट masculine, टिप feminine, फ़ाइल feminine, स्कूल masculine. Nothing predicts it.

game.explanation_en: वित्त is finance, as in वित्त मंत्री. ख़र्च is expenditure and कटौती is a cut or reduction.

tts_strings: वित्त मंत्री ने बजट प्रस्तुत किया।
बजट सत्र सोमवार से शुरू होगा।

items.pronunciation_notes: Refer to romanized transliteration for pronunciation.

learn.title_en: विकसित and विकासशील — developed and developing
learn.explanation_en: विकास is development, masculine and consonant-final, so flag it. Its family is worth learning together: विकसित means developed, and विकासशील means developing, using the suffix -शील, which means tending towards or having the quality of. That suffix builds a small set — सहनशील tolerant, परिवर्तनशील changeable — and it is the same -शील as in भाग्यशाली's cousin. विकासशील देश, a developing country, is a phrase you will meet in any news report about economics.

examples.hindi: क्षेत्र में विकास की ज़रूरत है।
examples.read_as: kṣetra meṁ vikaas kii zaruurat hai.
examples.note: की ज़रूरत, from level 1.
विकासशील, invariable.

examples.hindi: यह इलाक़ा अब काफ़ी विकसित है।
examples.read_as: yah ilaaqaa ab kaafii viksit hai.
examples.english: This area is now quite developed.
examples.note: विकसित, with the vowel shortened from विकास.

common_error.wrong: विकास की योजना बड़ी है — with विकास treated as feminine
common_error.why_en: विकास is masculine. In विकास की योजना, the की agrees with योजना, not with विकास — watch which noun the postposition is pointing at.

learn.title_en: संसद and सांसद — one vowel apart
learn.explanation_en: संसद is parliament, feminine and consonant-final, so flag it. And there is a trap sitting right beside it: सांसद, with a long आ in the first syllable, is a member of parliament — a person, masculine. One vowel separates the institution from the individual, and in fast speech or careless reading they are easy to confuse. संसदीय is parliamentary, using the -ईय suffix that also gave आदरणीय and स्थानीय.

examples.hindi: संसद में बहस चल रही है।
examples.read_as: saṁsad meṁ bahas chal rahii hai.
examples.english: A debate is going on in parliament.
examples.note: बहस from level 12, also feminine.

examples.hindi: वो तीन बार सांसद रह चुके हैं।

examples.note: सांसद, the person. रह चुके, the completive — a Module 14 construction met here in passing.
परंपरा — tradition, and another -आ feminine from level 35.

common_error.why_en: A parliament does not speak; a member of it does. The long vowel is the whole difference.

practice.prompt_en: What is the difference between संसद and सांसद?
options: संसद is parliament; सांसद is a member of it
संसद is the building; सांसद is the session
practice.explanation_en: One vowel apart, and one is an institution while the other is a person.

game.question_en: Which word means a legislative assembly at state level?
game.explanation_en: विधानसभा is a state assembly — विधान, legislation, plus सभा, assembly. And सभा is another -आ feminine.

summary.recap_en: A loanword's gender is assigned and unpredictable — बजट masculine, टिप feminine, and nothing to derive. -शील builds adjectives of tendency: विकासशील, सहनशील. And संसद against सांसद is one long vowel between an institution and a person.
